LOW_SEQUENTIAL.rule: Resolve the upstream dependency before dispatching downstream analysis.

MEDIUM_PARTIAL.rule: Parallelize only independent subquestions; represent dependencies explicitly.

HIGH_INDEPENDENT.rule: Fan out only across distinct source, method or failure-mode families; duplicate prompts do not count as diversity.

examples.task: contract rules -> payoff proof -> executable economics
examples.recommended: one dependency stage at a time

examples.task: attack candidate across semantic, leakage and execution failure modes
examples.recommended: independent attacks may fan out, final adjudication waits for all required attacks

examples.task: formal search over many independent payoff relation families
examples.recommended: local deterministic enumeration first; model workers inspect novel residuals

guardrails: No fanout solely to keep workers busy.
Do not ask multiple workers the identical question and treat agreement as independent evidence.
Use local deterministic computation before model fanout when exhaustive filtering is cheaper and exact.
Every worker must receive a distinct decisive question, source family or failure-mode objective when fanout > 1.
Director records why the chosen fanout matches the task shape.
